title: Summary clock
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and state set $Q$, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean input. Define a Boolean-valued summary from a configuration $c$, an optional Boolean summary $s$, and a natural time bound. At time zero its value is true exactly when $c$ is halted and $s$ is the Boolean value true; at one more than time $t$, its value is the summary at time $t$ of the successor configuration after one step of $M$, using as the updated summary the result of combining $s$ with the optional symbol emitted by that step (retaining $s$ if no symbol is emitted, setting the result to true when the first emitted symbol is true, and setting it to false otherwise).
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and states in $Q$
the time bound is a natural number
the summary is an optional Boolean
